Trusted verification is green (exit 0: typecheck PASS, 588 Jest tests / 28 suites PASS, privacy release contract PASS with 71 focused tests, cost regression gates PASS with 21 gates, i18n catalog parity PASS with 9 tests, Expo Android export PASS), so the blocker is not infrastructure or gates — it is the missing V4-05 UI work. The Auditor's three must-fix findings are confirmed against the source: (1) app/(tabs)/balances.tsx history rows (lines 894-917) are read-only Text with no onPress and no Edit/Delete/Share actions, so 'edit tâche depuis Balances', 'edit dépense depuis Balances', 'delete replay/tombstone correct' and 'share natif depuis Balances' are unmet; (2) app/(tabs)/add.tsx has no edit mode — no entryId/entryType route params, no pre-fill, no update submission path, leaving the existing add.editBanner/add.update/add.errorEdit/add.errorDelete keys unused; (3) src/i18n/catalog.ts lacks the history-action keys (balances.editEntry, balances.deleteEntry, balances.shareEntry, balances.deleteConfirmTask, balances.deleteConfirmExpense, balances.editTask, balances.editExpense) in both FR and EN. The repository layer already exposes update/delete for ContributionEntry and ExpenseEntry (ScopedRepositoryFacade, InMemoryRepositories, SqliteRepositories, SyncRecordingWrapper) and domain tests confirm zero-sum invariants hold after edit/delete, so the repair is a focused UI-layer tranche: make Balances history rows interactive with an action sheet (Edit/Delete/Share), add edit mode to add.tsx reusing the existing create form, add the missing i18n keys with correct French accents, and verify delta refresh after edit/delete. The candidate baseline is retained; reconstruction is forbidden. V4-05 stays the active criterion; no V4-06 work starts until the must-fix findings are resolved and the criterion is re-audited.
